name: project-docs
description: Specialized workflows for project documentation baselines, refactoring, README, planning, architecture, and agent guidance.

interface.longDescription: Use six focused skills to initialize a documentation baseline, refactor documentation structure, maintain README files, manage planning documents, describe architecture and decisions, or refine repository agent guidance.
defaultPrompt: Use project-docs-bootstrap to initialize a minimal documentation baseline for this repository.
Use project-docs-refactor to audit or reorganize this repository's documentation structure and ownership.
Use project-docs-readme to create or maintain the root README and its official translations.
Use project-docs-planning to design or maintain this repository's TODO.md, roadmaps, milestones, backlog, tasks, and implementation plans.
Use project-docs-architecture to maintain current or target architecture, Mermaid diagrams, and ADRs.
Use project-docs-guidance to create or refine repository agent-guidance files and scoped rules.
